title: 第二十八章 地牢供词崖前取密信第二十七章 武师压境青鳞逆斩强敌
lines: 晚风卷着残留血气，漫过西落院青石地面。
墨老被执法护卫押离院落，铁链拖地发出刺耳哐当声响，那一句冥阁阁主已至永安郡，如同沉石落潭，压得人心头沉郁。
镇北侯沈苍伫立院中，蟒纹衣袍垂落，眉眼沉沉看向身前青衫少年。
方才一战，沈砚以武徒三重之境，引爆蛟血肉身，硬生生击溃废掉武师一重墨老，这份越级战力，早已超脱青阳城同辈范畴，甚至足以比肩郡城中小宗门核心弟子。
此前他心底尚存几分拿捏、制衡之心，此刻尽数消散，只剩实打实的忌惮。
沈惊鸿天赋绝世，其子沈砚，更胜其父。
“冥阁盘踞域外西荒百年，势力远超永安郡本土所有武道势力，阁内层级分明，阁主之下，设四大护阁武尊，麾下死士无数，专职搜集特殊体质、血脉武者，用以秘境献祭。”
沈苍开口，语气褪去往日王侯疏离，多了几分正色凝重，直白道出冥阁底蕴，“墨老只是域外外派的底层统领，此次入境永安郡，只是先行棋子，真正执掌杀伐的，是亲临郡城的冥阁阁主。”
一旁阿禾扶着气血亏虚的沈砚，闻言心头一紧，低声开口：“侯爷，郡城武道庇护，真的能挡住冥阁阁主吗？对方乃是域外顶尖强者。”
“挡不住全部。”
沈苍并未虚言宽慰，直言利弊，“郡城武道盛会由永安郡守亲自主持，郡守乃是半步武灵强者，手握郡城镇域阵印，可震慑入境域外武者，能压下冥阁阁主明面杀伐，但无法阻拦对方暗处布局刺杀。”
换言之，拿下盛会第一，可得明面安稳，暗处杀机，依旧不绝。
这也是沈砚不得不参赛的缘由。
沈砚抬手平复体内翻涌气血，经脉劳损刺痛阵阵传来，越级对战武师的后遗症彻底显现，四肢酸胀灵力滞涩，蛟鳞血脉消耗过半，短时间难以二次催动覆体。
他抬眸看向沈苍，语气平静直击核心：“墨老关押在地牢何处？我要亲自审讯。”
墨老蛰伏侯府五年，知晓全部旧事脉络，知晓冥阁献祭秘境详情，知晓父母当年域外最终下落，比起秦守常规审讯，由自己问话，才能拿到最真实的情报。
“侯府地底锁灵地牢，布有封灵阵法，废功墨老无法挣脱，可随时探视审讯。”沈苍颔首应允，毫无阻拦，“我会命人撤去地牢外围禁制，给你单独审讯空间，今日之内，你可随意问话。”
如今二者恩怨对半厘清，沈苍无意再遮掩旧事，也愿意成全沈砚查清双亲真相，算是弥补早年构陷过错。
除此之外，沈苍指尖取出一枚青色玉牌，隔空抛至沈砚手中：“藏经阁二层准入玉牌升级，此为三层通行玉令，阁内身法、淬体秘术、克制域外煞气功法，尽数可阅。三日武道盛会在即，你修为虽强，但搏杀经验单一，缺高阶身法应变。”
玉牌温润厚重，镌刻侯府专属蟒纹，是镇北侯府极少数嫡系才可持有的高阶令牌。
沈砚攥住玉令，没有推辞道谢。
当下局势，客套无用，补强自身战力，才是活命、查真相的底气。
“多谢侯爷。”
“不必谢我，我只是赎罪。”沈苍摇头，目光望向思过崖漆黑山影，“柳氏囚于思过崖主峰囚室，地牢审讯完毕，你可自行上山见她，她手中冥阁密信，是当年三方缔约原件，记载比墨老口供更加完整。”
交代完毕，沈苍转身离去，护卫随行清场，西落院彻底归于安静。
阿禾扶着沈砚落座廊下，取出疗伤丹药递上前：“公子，先服凝脉丹修复经脉，地牢阴冷煞气重，贸然前往会加重内伤。”
沈砚接过丹药咽下，温润药力入喉，缓缓滋养开裂经脉，放缓气息调息半刻钟，周身气色好转几分。
“你留守院内，加固院门，我先去锁灵地牢审讯墨老，之后去往思过崖。”
沈砚起身整理微乱青衫，眼底锋芒收敛，只剩沉稳冷静，“如今所有线索闭环，墨老、柳氏两处口供对上，便能拼凑父母五年前完整生死轨迹。”
从前他寻真相，是为洗冤复仇，如今多了一重活下去的理由——打破冥阁血脉献祭棋局，不让父母当年隐忍逃亡，沦为一场笑话。
“公子务必小心地牢埋伏，虽说侯爷放行，但地牢旧部多是三房旧时亲信。”阿禾躬身叮嘱，满心担忧。
“无妨。”
沈砚抬脚迈步，循着府内青石甬道，直奔府邸西侧地底锁灵地牢而去。
镇北侯府锁灵地牢，修建于府底百丈之下，通体黑石堆砌，阵法封禁灵力，常年阴冷潮湿，浊气积郁，专门关押重犯、外敌强者。
地牢入口有两名执法护卫值守，看见沈砚手中三层藏经阁玉令，外加侯爷提前传令，立刻躬身行礼，主动开启地牢石门。
厚重石门嘎吱开启，刺骨阴冷浊气扑面而来，夹杂铁锈血腥、霉腐气息，扑面而来。
“沈公子，墨老关押最深处单间，封灵阵法已调低档位，无法压制您的灵力，属下在外值守，绝不靠近打扰。”护卫低声禀报。
沈砚微微颔首，独身踏入地牢深处。
甬道狭长幽暗，壁上幽火摇曳，光影晃动，拉长少年身形。一路走来，两侧囚室关押各类府内重犯，皆是当年依附三房作恶之人，看见独行青衫少年，尽数噤声缩至角落，不敢直视。
content_en:
The evening wind carried the residual blood energy and spread over the bluestone floor of the West Falling Courtyard.
Mr. Mo was escorted away from the courtyard by the law enforcement guards. The iron chains dragged on the ground with a harsh clanking sound. The words that the master of the Ming Pavilion had arrived in Yong'an County were like a stone falling into a pond, which made people feel depressed.
Zhenbei Marquis Shen Cang stood in the courtyard, his python-patterned robe hanging down, looking at the young man in green shirt in front of him with serious eyebrows.
In the battle just now, Shen Yan used his third-level martial arts status to detonate his flesh and blood, and forcibly defeated the first-level martial artist Mo Lao. This level of combat power has already surpassed the peers in Qingyang City, and is even comparable to the core disciples of small sects in the county.
Before, he still had some sense of control and balance in his heart, but now it all dissipated, leaving only real fear.
Shen Jinghong was extremely talented, and his son Shen Yan was even better than his father.
"The Ming Pavilion has been entrenched in the Western Wilderness outside the territory for hundreds of years. Its power far exceeds all the local martial arts forces in Yong'an County. The hierarchy within the pavilion is clear. Under the pavilion master, there are four pavilion-protecting Martial Lords with countless dead soldiers under their command. They specialize in collecting warriors with special physiques and bloodlines to sacrifice in the secret realm."
When Shen Cang spoke, his tone lost the alienation of the princes in the past and became more solemn. He spoke straightforwardly about the background of Ming Pavilion, "Mr. Mo is just a low-level commander of the foreign mission. When he entered Yong'an County this time, he was just a chess piece. The one who is really in charge of the killing is the master of Ming Pavilion who came to the county in person."
On the side, Ah He supported Shen Yan, who was weak in energy and blood. Hearing this, his heart tightened and he spoke in a low voice: "Master Marquis, can the martial arts protection of the county and city really stop the master of the Ming Pavilion? The opponent is a top expert from outside the territory."
"Can't stop them all."
Shen Cang did not pretend to be relieved, but spoke frankly about the pros and cons, "The martial arts event in the county is personally hosted by Yong'an County Sheriff. The county guard is a half-step martial arts expert. He holds the county and town's territorial formation seal. He can intimidate foreign warriors who enter the territory. He can suppress the Ming Pavilion Master's overt attack, but he cannot stop the other party from plotting an assassination secretly."
In other words, by winning the first place in the grand event, you can gain stability in the open world, but still have endless murderous intentions in the dark.
This is also the reason why Shen Yan had to participate.
Shen Yan raised his hand to calm down the surging energy and blood in his body. Painful pains came from the strained meridians. The sequelae of the leapfrog battle against the martial artist were fully revealed. His limbs were sore and swollen, his spiritual energy was stagnant, and his blood vessels in the dragon scales were depleted by more than half. It was difficult to activate the body for the second time in a short time.
He raised his eyes to look at Shen Cang, and his tone was calm and straight to the core: "Where is Mr. Mo detained in the dungeon? I want to interrogate him personally."
Mr. Mo has been dormant in the Marquis Mansion for five years and knows all the past events, the details of the secret place of sacrifice in the Ming Pavilion, and the final whereabouts of his parents outside the territory. Compared with Qin Shou's regular interrogation, only by asking questions himself can he get the most authentic information.
"The spirit-locking dungeon under the Marquis Mansion is equipped with a spirit-sealing formation. Mr. Mo can't break free. He can visit and interrogate at any time." Shen Cang nodded and agreed without any obstruction. "I will order people to remove the restrictions outside the dungeon and give you a separate interrogation space. You can ask questions at will today."
Now that the grudge between the two has been clarified, Shen Cang has no intention of covering up the past, and is willing to help Shen Yan find out the truth about his parents, which can make up for his mistakes in the early years.
In addition, Shen Cang took out a blue jade token from his fingertips and threw it into Shen Yan's hand: "The access jade token for the second floor of the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion is upgraded. This is the jade order for the third floor. You can read all the body techniques in the pavilion, body tempering secrets, and techniques for restraining evil spirits outside the territory. The three-day martial arts event is coming soon. Although your cultivation is strong, your fighting experience is single and you lack the adaptability of high-level body techniques."
The jade token is warm and thick, engraved with the python pattern exclusive to the Hou Mansion. It is a high-level token that can only be held by a very small number of direct descendants of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion.
Shen Yan held onto the jade order and did not refuse to thank him.
In the current situation, being polite is useless. Strengthening one's own combat power is the confidence to survive and find out the truth.
"Thank you, Lord Marquis."
"There's no need to thank me, I'm just atonement." Shen Cang shook his head and looked at the dark mountain shadow of Siguo Cliff. "Liu is imprisoned in the cell on the main peak of Siguo Cliff. After the interrogation in the dungeon, you can go up the mountain to see her by yourself. The secret letter from the Ming Pavilion in her hand is the original of the three-party contract, and the record is more complete than Old Mo's confession."
After the explanation, Shen Cang turned around and left, followed by guards to clear the place, and Xiluoyuan became completely quiet.
Ah He helped Shen Yan sit down on the corridor, took out the healing elixir and handed it to him: "Sir, take the Pulse Ning Dan to repair the meridians first. The dungeon is cold and evil, and going there rashly will aggravate the internal injuries."
Shen Yan took the elixir and swallowed it. The warm and moist medicine went into his throat, slowly nourishing the cracked meridians. He slowed down his breath and adjusted his breathing for half a quarter of an hour, and his whole body complexion improved a little.
"You stay in the courtyard and reinforce the gate. I will go to Suoling Dungeon to interrogate Mr. Mo first, and then go to Siguo Cliff."
Shen Yan stood up and straightened his slightly messy blue shirt. The sharpness in his eyes shrank, leaving only calmness and calmness. "Now all the clues are closed. If the two confessions of Mr. Mo and Mrs. Liu are matched, we can piece together the complete life and death trajectory of my parents five years ago."
In the past, he sought the truth to avenge his grievances, but now he has another reason to live - to break the Ming Pavilion bloodline sacrifice chess game and prevent his parents from hiding and running away, turning it into a joke.
"Young master, you must be careful of ambush in the dungeon. Although the Marquis has given permission, most of the old men in the dungeon are the old confidants of Sanfang." Ah He bowed and warned, full of worry.
"It doesn't matter."
Shen Yan stepped forward, followed the bluestone corridor in the mansion, and went straight to the underground spirit lock dungeon on the west side of the mansion.
The Spirit Locking Dungeon of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion was built hundreds of feet below the mansion. It was made of black stones and formed into formations to seal off spiritual power. It was cold and damp all year round, and the turbid air accumulated. It was specially designed to imprison felons and powerful foreign enemies.
There were two law enforcement guards on duty at the entrance of the dungeon. When they saw the jade order of the three-storey Sutra Pavilion in Shen Yan's hand, and the order from the Marquis in advance, they immediately bowed and saluted, and took the initiative to open the stone door of the dungeon.
The thick stone door creaked open, and biting cold turbid air rushed in, mixed with the smell of rust, blood, and mold and rot.
"Mr. Shen, Mr. Mo is in the deepest cell of the prison. The spirit-sealing formation has been set to a low level and cannot suppress your spiritual power. My subordinates are on duty outside and will not come near to disturb you." The guard reported in a low voice.
Shen Yan nodded slightly and stepped into the depths of the dungeon alone.
The corridor is long and dark, with fire flickering on the wall
title_en: Chapter 28: Obtaining the Secret Message from the Confession Cliff in the Dungeon Chapter 27: The Martial Master Presses the Green Scales and Kills the Strong Enemy in Counterattack
